OPENEPAPERLINK · RP2040-ZERO

Back up the entire tag.

Download every byte of the tag’s main flash, including firmware, settings and calibration data. Everything runs locally in your browser.

1. Prepare the programmer

Install RP2040 bridge v1.6 UF2 using BOOTSEL, then reconnect normally. The tag needs no firmware update.

Power the tag from 3.3 V with its batteries removed. Use short leads and a common ground.

Full wiring and firmware instructions

Wire the tag to the Zero

GP0 through 1 kΩSWS
GP1 directlySWS
GP2RST
3V3VCC

GP4/GP5 UART wires are optional for backup.

2. Connect the RP2040

Choose the programmer, then its SWS readback serial port (first interface / if00). Close other flashers and serial monitors first.

No programmer connected.

The v1.4/v1.5/v1.6 bridge defaults to 2 Mbaud. Previous Python bench reads took about 30 seconds per 512 KiB pass at this rate; browser timing may differ. If verification fails, reconnect and select 1.5 Mbaud before choosing the serial port. With this option off, verification checks 256-byte samples every 64 KiB and at the end.

3. Capture and download

Ready when you connect the programmer.

The tag pauses during capture and is reset afterward. The dumper issues no flash erase, program or unlock commands.
